title: A phone, a cup, and a book get tried for their ordinary jobs
summary: By about 15 months, most children try to use a phone, a cup, or a book in the ordinary way, the U.S. CDC says.
body: Separate from the block tower, the CDC 15-month cognitive list includes trying to use things the right way, like a phone, a cup, or a book. The agency counts the item when at least three quarters of children do it by that age. It warns the handout cannot stand in for standardized, validated developmental screening tools. Using a cup as a cup is not a medical finding either way. Charts published in other countries are not this chart.
